messages.subject: scr-rsf model fails to run with large amount of telemetry fixes - wondering why?
messages.subject_clean: scr-rsf model fails to run with large amount of telemetry fixes - wondering why?
messages.body_plain:
Hello all,

I ran scr-rsf models with additional telemetry data from gps-collared individuals. I am curious about an error I got during the process.

At first, the thinned telemetry dataset still had some individuals with a large amount of telemetry fixes (~500 each). When data from these individuals was included, the models failed to converge (error message: Something went wrong! Try better starting values.) When the individuals were removed, or the data from these individuals was thinned further to ~100 points or less, the models ran w/o issues. Ultimately I just thinned the data to a greater extent so these individuals could be included, and everything went smoothly, but I am curious if there is an explanation why too much telemetry data might cause an error like this?

Thank you!

Greta

messages.body_plain:
Hi Greta,

We’ve found that the model can be sensitive to extreme movements. Thinning can often remove them, though obviously that’s not guaranteed.

If you send me the data I could potentially help you diagnose. One thing that is important is plotting all the points for each individual in the state space to see what the distribution looks like and how initial values for sigma need to be set. Unfortunately it can be very tricky!

-Dan
